messages:
tara: Hi -- had a quick one. Took rideshares during a short trip to Berlin. I lost one receipt (the driver didn't email it). I have the trip history screenshot from the app showing date/time, route, and amount in EUR, plus my card statement. Is that enough to submit the expense? cc @raj :pray:

raj: Usually yes. For rideshares we accept either a detailed in-app receipt or the trip history screenshot + bank/card txn. Important: include a note that the driver didn't provide a receipt. Also keep the currency in EUR and include a conversion note if you want reimbursement in USD.

tara: Follow-up: the app shows 'service fee' and 'tip' as separate line items, but my card only billed the total. Do I need separate proof for the tip?

raj: For tips paid through the app, the trip history showing the tip line is sufficient. If you tipped cash to the driver, that cash tip is not reimbursable unless pre-approved. Company policy: tips via the payment method are reimbursable up to local guidelines.

people-ops: Quick policy snippet:
```
Rideshare receipts: Acceptable docs = in-app receipt OR app trip history + card statement.
- Retain original currency amounts.
- App-provided tip lines are reimbursable if charged via the card.
- Cash tips are out-of-pocket unless manager sign-off.
```

tara: Cool. One more edge case: I split the fare with a colleague and paid half through the app and half cash. My card shows only my half. What do I attach?

raj: Attach your in-app payment confirmation for your portion + a short note describing the split and the coworker's name. If they paid you back in cash, that's personal and not part of the company's expense. If you paid the full fare then got reimbursed privately, we only reimburse the company-eligible portion you charged on your card.

finance-bot: Reminder — expenses without receipts over $75 may be flagged for audit. Upload what you have to avoid delays.

tara: Got it. Also, what's the recommended exchange-rate proof? I used the card (converted by my bank).

raj: If your bank charged in USD, include the card statement showing the converted USD amount. If you want to show the conversion, a screenshot of the Google conversion on the transaction date is fine. No need for a precise FX vendor, just document the rate/date.

tara: Thanks, that's helpful. I'll upload: app trip screenshot, card stmt line, and a brief expense note explaining the split and tip.

raj: Perfect — that'll clear. If finance flags anything we'll follow up, but this matches previous approvals. :thumbsup:
